c: Knife throws projectiles in the direction the player is moving or last moved. It ignores

are fired in short volleys in parallel. The firing Interval is decreased on levels 4, 6 and 8, grouping each volley of knives closer together. Each knife can initially hit one enemy before dissipating. They cannot pass through walls.
While playing with a keyboard, the knives can only be shot out in eight cardinal and ordinal directions. When playing with a mouse or gamepad, the knives can be fired in any direction.
